decisions.reason: Because the accelerator stayed on the home page for two years and supports the firm's partnership-led circular-growth narrative, management is likely to justify and continue it despite its more peripheral fit and lower sunk cost than plant-based offerings.

The binder appears to embody substantial R&D and sustainability commitment and remained on its own page through 2024, so management is inclined to persist and attribute any slow traction to market-development timing rather than abandon it now.

As a machinery-intensive product close to the core offer and still featured on the home page in 2024, it carries high strategic and reputational commitment, making continued support the most likely choice.
